how your Product model already works.

_catalogue_items_not_seeded: 'Appointment Scheduling' and 'Services Disclaimer' are in your WhatsApp
catalogue but are not products. Scheduling belongs in the booking flow,
and the disclaimer is already a page at /disclaimer/. Selling either as a
catalogue line would put them in a shopping cart.
Worth noting: your catalogue's own Services Disclaimer card states the
same scope the website now states — not a testing laboratory, no on-site
testing, no medical/legal/genetic advice, sample coordination only. The
two now agree, which is what you want if anyone compares them.
